title: The activities switching applet doesn't display the wallpaper if 'Wallpaper of  the day' was selected for that specific activity
line: The Activities switcher now shows the Picture of the Day or the current slideshow image on each activity's tile instead of a stale or default wallpaper.
explanation: The activity switcher finds each activity's wallpaper in the desktop's config, and backgroundFromConfig() only understood the Image and Color plugins, so Picture of the Day and Slideshow tiles kept a stale or default image. Picture of the Day never saved which picture it shows, and the slideshow only saved its current slide when plasmashell quit. Now Picture of the Day saves the local URL of the image it shows in a new Image entry whenever it changes (kdeplasma-addons), the slideshow also writes its current slide to disk a few seconds after each change (plasma-workspace), and the switcher reads the Image entry for both plugins like it does for Image (plasma-desktop).

commits.message:
activitymanager: show Picture of the Day and slideshow wallpapers

Activity tiles only read image and color wallpapers, so an activity with
Picture of the Day or a slideshow kept a stale or default tile. Read the
Image entry, where both now save the picture they show, like Image does.

BUG: 449823

wallpapers/potd: save the shown image in the config

Other components, like the activity switcher, had no way to know which
picture the wallpaper shows short of guessing from its cache. Save the
image's local URL as Image whenever it changes, like the slideshow does.

BUG: 449823

wallpapers/image: save the current slide when it changes

The slideshow only wrote its current slide to disk on quit, so the
activity switcher showed a slide from the previous session at best. Also
write it after each change, at most once every five seconds.

BUG: 449823

patches.diff:
From 537f2b7ef31cf30bb6719581708217326182d972 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 00:28:31 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wallpapers/potd: save the shown image in the config

Other components, like the activity switcher, had no way to know which
picture the wallpaper shows short of guessing from its cache. Save the
image's local URL as Image whenever it changes, like the slideshow does.

BUG: 449823
---
 wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml |  3 +++
 wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml     | 11 ++++++++++-
 2 files changed, 13 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml
index a66b98e5c..6553fa555 100644
--- a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml
+++ b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml
@@ -22,6 +22,9 @@
       <label>Update wallpaper over metered connection. 0 - False, 1 - True, 2 - True when data usage is below limit (not implemented)</label>
       <default>0</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="Image" type="String">
+      <label>URL of the image currently shown, for other components such as the activity switcher</label>
+    </entry>
   </group>
 
 </kcfg>
diff --git a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml
index b179ce7e6..48fdde753 100644
--- a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml
@@ -101,7 +101,16 @@ WallpaperItem {
             updateOverMeteredConnection: root.configuration.UpdateOverMeteredConnection
 
             onImageChanged: Qt.callLater(imageView.loadImage)
-            onLocalUrlChanged: Qt.callLater(imageView.loadImage)
+            onLocalUrlChanged: {
+                Qt.callLater(imageView.loadImage);
+                if (localUrl.length > 0) {
+                    const image = Qt.resolvedUrl(localUrl).toString();
+                    if (root.configuration.Image !== image) {
+                        root.configuration.Image = image;
+                        root.configuration.writeConfig();
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }
 
         Component {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: desktop set to Picture of the Day (Bing); the Default tile still shows the old wallpaper
Fixed: same steps, the tile shows the Bing picture
Master: slideshow every 20 s; the tile shows the default wallpaper whatever the slide
Fixed: switcher open during the slideshow; the tile follows each new slide a few seconds later
